# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for known external library and test framework races.

# olink_core RemoteRegistry has unsynchronized concurrent access to hash maps.
# This is a bug in the external olink_core library, not in our code.
race:ApiGear::ObjectLink::RemoteRegistry::registerNode
race:ApiGear::ObjectLink::RemoteRegistry::addNodeForSource

# Catch2 RunContext is not thread-safe for assertions from multiple threads.
# trompeloeil mock callbacks assert from ThreadPool worker threads while the
# main thread also asserts, causing benign races on Catch2 internal state.
race:Catch::RunContext::handleExpr
race:Catch::RunContext::reportExpr
